description:
Make the validation capture return the records it already parsed, so the report and the divergence view read them instead of parsing the index and every issue again.

## Background

- `capture_proposed_base_inner` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:365-513`) parses every issue during capture to plan the closure (`:478-498`) and returns the image with those issues; `capture_base_reading` (`:211-238`) keeps the issues only for document-reference discovery and returns the image alone.
- `capture_validation_report` (`:547-586`) then builds `CapturedValidation::from_image`, which parses the records again, and `captured_divergences` (`:706-741`) parses them a third time through the records loader.
- Capture parses the overlay-effective bytes before the overlay is applied, which equals a parse of the overlaid image.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The validation capture returns a `CapturedValidation` holding the records it parsed, and the CLI validation path, `--fix` repair planning and the divergence view read those records; on this path the index and each issue record are parsed once.
- [hard] REQ-02: `captured_divergences` derives divergences from the captured records and parses nothing.
- [hard] REQ-03: Output is unchanged: the validation, divergence and repair suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validation capture hands its parsed records to the report
